title: Global center of polynomial Newton system and its non-isochronicity
summary: Using a new compactification (toroidal compactification) and desingularization, we obtain a complete characterization of monodromy at infinity for polynomial Newton system of arbitrary degree, in which we establish an equivalence between the monodromy and the non-existence of 1/2-fractional formal invariant curves. Combining the complete characterization with either Darboux integrability or algebraic reducibility of local centers, we obtain conditions for all cases of global center.
